headline: Expiry-day trades are costing you a lot.

expiry_day_trading.why_it_matters: The expiry-day slice cost you ₹1,16,891 in this window. It involved 90 trades, produced a loss of ₹1,16,891, averaged a loss of ₹1,299 per trade, had a win rate of 29% and an average return of a 28% loss. By contrast, the remaining 124 trades averaged a loss of ₹449, showed a 5% loss on average, and had a win rate of 37%.
expiry_day_trading.rule: Set a hard cap on expiry-day trades before the open.

closing: Consider applying the rule for expiry-day trades in the next window.
